title: Optimize runtime kernel dispatch for mixed-precision paths (FP16/FP8/INT8)
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem statement: We need a robust runtime dispatch strategy that automatically selects per-operator kernel implementations across FP16, FP8 (e4m3/e5m2 family), and INT8 variants while preserving model quality and providing predictable latency/cost. Current runtime uses coarse-grained precision toggles which either miss cost savings or cause quality regressions. This ticket defines calibration and accuracy-validation workflows, the dispatch heuristics, and the kernel-selection metadata that the runtime will consult at request time.

Goals:
- Enable per-op mixed precision: allow different layers/operators to use FP16/FP8/INT8 as appropriate.
- Provide offline calibration flow to produce per-model quantization profiles.
- Validate accuracy with automated eval suites and gate quantized rollouts.
- Implement a dispatch table and runtime checks for graceful fallback and telemetry.

Scope:
- Calibration tooling (collector + quant-sim) that outputs a compact quant profile JSON.
- Runtime dispatch API that consumes quant profiles and hardware capability flags to pick kernels.
- Accuracy validation harness integrated with Redwood evals to run gating checks pre-rollout.
- Telemetry and perf/accuracy dashboards for ongoing monitoring.
acceptance_criteria: Calibration job produces a per-model quant profile JSON that maps at least all transformer linear, attention, and layernorm ops to candidate precisions and scale params.
Runtime dispatch picks kernels deterministically for a given profile+hardware and falls back to FP16 when accuracy/policy dictates.
End-to-end eval on the gate suite shows <=0.5% absolute quality degradation (or model-specific threshold configured in profile) for accepted profiles.
Performance: quantized dispatch must show >=1.25x tokens/sec improvement or >=15% cost reduction on targeted GPU types for accepted profiles compared to baseline FP16 for representative workloads.
A/B rollout capability: we can route 5/95, 20/80 traffic splits to a quantized variant and collect latency, error, and quality metrics in Console dashboards.
success_metrics: Average inference cost reduction per-token >= 15% on eligible models
Quantized models adopted by at least 3 major customers in beta within first month
No critical regressions flagged by quality monitors (auto-alerts) after rollout
risks_mitigation: Risk: FP8/INT8 may introduce intermittent accuracy regressions on outlier inputs. Mitigation: require representative calibration dataset and run full evals before rollout; provide automatic rollback on quality signal.
Risk: Hardware kernel availability differs across instance types. Mitigation: dispatch table includes required_hw and feature flags; runtime falls back to FP16 if kernel not available.
Risk: Increased complexity in debugging. Mitigation: include per-request precision footprint telemetry and a 'replay' mode to re-run requests with different precisions for root-cause analysis.
implementation_plan: 1) Calibration collector: instrument export hooks in model loader to collect activation histograms (buckets + per-channel where applicable) using a representative sample set (default 512 samples).

2) Quant-sim worker: run offline simulated quantization per-layer using both percentile clipping (99.9/99.99) and KL-divergence heuristics; produce candidate scale factors for FP8(e4m3/e5m2) and INT8 (symmetric per-channel).

3) Profile generator: emit profile JSON with entries: layer_name, op_type, weight_scale, act_scale, candidate_precisions (ordered preference), estimated_accuracy_penalty, estimated_perf_gain, required_hardware_flags. Keep profile <= 64KB for fast distribution.

4) Accuracy validator: run gated eval suite (NLP benchmarks + customer-derived prompt sets) comparing baseline FP16 vs quantized simulation; compute delta metrics and tag profile 'accept'/'reject' with failure reasons.

5) Runtime dispatch: implement a dispatch table lookup that uses (profile, model_version, runtime_hw_caps, policy) to pick kernel. Add fast path: if profile says 'force_fp16' for layer, skip quant path.
6) Telemetry: emit per-request header with precision-map and per-op execution timing; integrate into Console to visualize accuracy regressions and latency/cost tradeoffs.
7) Rollout: start canary with 5% traffic, monitor quality metrics for 48h, then proceed to 20%/80% and full rollout if safe.
test_plan: Unit tests for quant-sim to validate round-trip error metrics for toy models
Integration test: run calibration end-to-end on small transformer (GPT-2 small) and verify runtime dispatch yields same outputs within thresholds when using deterministic RNG seeds
E2E performance: benchmark latency and throughput across target GPU types (A100, H100, GH200) with both power-limited and throughput-limited profiles
Regression gating: automated daily job that runs accepted profiles against 10k sampled prompts and alerts on metric drift > thresholds
rollout_plan: Stage 0: Internal dev-only validation with synthetic workloads (1 day)
Stage 1: Beta customers + select internal services (5% traffic, 48h)
Stage 3: Default for eligible models once thresholds maintained for 7 days
